title: Adda xer weeqa
intro: Kaxxa Racmatta le numih taama abeyni giddile agattiinak taqbeeh, idini yomcowweemik afal yewqeh. Tama numtin amoh num elle sugeh yan aracal, Divine seeco qibnaytuh diteh addat geytimta. qaku luk cattiimak takkay immay milaagimeh, ta rooci wakti sinni baritto yekke sabriiy, baguuk toobokee kee waado sinni racmatta Gine. Atu cuumi faktam duuddaa?
clues: Anu inni ummattah farmoytah ruubeh suge, takkay immay oson sinni kufrih addat inkih tan waadok tatureenih yabbeenim cineenih.
Anu ken cineemih bakcarriteh Yalli amri yamaateemik naharal yi ummattak kude.
Anu duddak dagah quuki markabat koreh, nanu mangom muucuneh miyyi doonik amol qidelem madaqnuh.
Anu naqabule badih addat qideeh, kaxxa kullumti yoh yanxuqe.
Sidiica qaynatih diteh addat culte — garba, baddi addah, kee ardi addah — anu inni Rabbih seeco abeh, toobokeh.
Anu kullumti addak fakut yan caraatal ewqeh, ecla kee taqbi, kee gourd caxa yok dadalteh. Yi ummatta, bool alfi akkek tohuuk daga, illacaboh yeemeneh.

outcome.label: Xalu
options: Kay ummatta, bool alfi akkek tohuuk daga, yeemeneh
outcome.answer: Kay ummatta, bool alfi akkek tohuuk daga, yeemeneh

arabic: وَأَرْسَلْنَـٰهُ إِلَىٰ مِا۟ئَةِ أَلْفٍ أَوْ يَزِيدُونَ
verse: And We sent him to [his people of] a hundred thousand or more. (37:147)
